title: Pogačar’s Viral Booty Band Warm-Up Routine Might Just Be a Placebo, but Here’s Why It Might Work for You
content:
Should cyclists warm up with mini bands? Why the placebo effect might outweigh any true muscle 'activation,' and how riders can make better use of glute bands.

Read the full article at Pogačar’s Viral Booty Band Warm-Up Routine Might Just Be a Placebo, but Here’s Why It Might Work for You on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
